data.notes: March 2026’s confirmed music calendar around Ischgl was centered on slope-side DJ and live-band events in Kappl and See, with Ischgl village represented by the Musikkapelle Ischgl spring concert.

events.title: Kronehit Berg Beat Tour
events.venueName: Sunny Mountain Terrace, Kappl Ski Area
events.summary: KRONEHIT brought its BergBeat Tour to the Kappl ski area for a winter rave on the slopes. The confirmed featured act was DJ INSTYLE, with the event listed from 13:00 to 17:00.

events.title: Medrig Night Fever: Marc Pircher & DJ Alex
events.summary: The March Medrig Night Fever date in See paired night skiing and tobogganing with a live concert on the Medrig Alm stage. The listed acts for 4 March 2026 were Marc Pircher and DJ Alex.

events.title: Läts Fetz Live at the Almstüberl
events.summary: Läts Fetz were confirmed for a live après-ski style performance at Almstüberl on piste no. 5 in the Kappl ski area. The official listing gives a start time of around 11:30.

events.title: Poederbaas Freeride Festival Kappl
events.summary: The Dutch Freeride Championships were confirmed as part of the Poederbaas Freeride Festival in Kappl from 14 to 21 March 2026. The official programme highlighted music-party components including Electronic Dias Kappl and “The Last Drop” party.

events.title: Electronic Dias Kappl
events.venueName: Roof terrace at Sunny Mountain, Kappl Ski Area
events.summary: Electronic Dias Kappl was confirmed as an open-air electronic festival above the clouds at Sunny Mountain. The listed lineup included Tiffany Seguí, Pvssycat, Marvin Aloys, Karotte and Sante Sansone.

events.title: “The Last Drop” Poederbaas Freeride Festival Kappl
events.summary: “The Last Drop” combined a waterslide contest with a closing party during the Poederbaas Freeride Festival. The confirmed DJ lineup was Sam Hofman, Luna & Lenthe, Jolani Jhones and Joshua Robbie, with DJ programming listed from 15:00 to 21:00.

events.title: Die Handwerker Live at the Almstüberl
events.summary: Die Handwerker were confirmed for a live mountain-hut performance at Almstüberl in the Kappl ski area. The official listing states Saturday, 21 March 2026, starting around 11:30.

events.title: Spring Concert of the Brass Orchestra Ischgl
events.summary: Musikkapelle Ischgl’s spring concert was confirmed on the Paznaun-Ischgl event calendar as a top event. The listing places it at Veranstaltungssaal Silvretta Therme on 28 March 2026 at 20:30.

events.title: Chris Live
events.venueName: Sunny Mountain Terrace, Kappl Ski Area
events.summary: Chris Live was confirmed for a slope-side live music set on the Sunny Mountain Terrace in the Kappl ski area. The official event page lists Saturday, 28 March 2026, with a 13:00 start.

events.title: Hüttenrallye See
events.summary: Hüttenrallye See was confirmed as a live-music hut-to-hut ski event with three bands at three mountain huts. The listed programme featured VolksBeat at Gratli, Marco Wahrstaetter Duo at Ascherhütte and Oidhoiz at Medrig Alm.
